export_3d_pose_to_spin_format: export 3D pose data from a dictionary to SPIN format and save as an npz file
extract_posetrack_annotations: extract PoseTrack COCO annotations into an npz file with keypoints, centers, and scales
convert_posetrack_to_smplcoco: convert PoseTrack 17 keypoints to SMPL-COCO 26 joint format with interpolated neck
load_posetrack_mocap_annotations: load PoseTrack COCO JSON annotations per tracked person from a directory of sequence files
review_posetrack_keypoint_conversion: review the Conv_posetrack_smplcocoTotal26 function that maps PoseTrack joints to SMPL-COCO and interpolates the neck
